### Better Promises for a Better Covenant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/better-promises-for-a-better-covenant
Passage: Hebrews 8:6-7
Points:
- Jesus exercises a superior priesthood because He mediates a covenant founded on better promises.
- Mosaic animal sacrifices could not provide complete pardon and only offered reminders of sin.
- The new covenant fulfills prophetic promises of inner heart renewal and lasting forgiveness.
- Saints under both the old and new eras are saved only through Christ's grace.
- Believers are called to proclaim Jesus as the sole Savior of humanity.

### 10 Things You Should Know about the New Covenant
Author: Sam Storms
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/10-things-you-should-know-about-the-new-covenant.html
Passage: Hebrews 8:6-13
Points:
- The Mosaic covenant showed God's standard but could not provide internal power to obey it.
- Jesus inaugurated a superior covenant through His blood as our Great High Priest.
- God writes His desires and law directly upon the believer's mind and heart.
- Every genuine participant in the new covenant experiences personal, saving fellowship with God.
- Christ's once-for-all sacrifice secures permanent forgiveness for all sins.
